title: ZXSpace Game Modes
seoTitle: ZXSpace Game Modes Guide | Solo City Defence | BarkinMad Studios
description: Explore ZXSpace's game modes, learn how Solo mode works, discover progression features and see what's planned for future updates.
summary: Master Solo mode as you defend cities against alien invasions and prepare for future gameplay experiences.

sections.heading: Choose Your Mission
paragraphs: ZXSpace is built around fast-paced arcade gameplay where every wave tests your reactions, positioning and defensive strategy. The game is designed to be easy to pick up while offering increasing challenge as your skills improve.
Solo Play is the core experience available today, with additional gameplay planned as the ZX Series continues to evolve.

sections.heading: Solo Play
paragraphs: Solo Play is the heart of ZXSpace. You control a single cannon and defend cities against increasingly dangerous waves of invading aliens. Every decision matters as you balance attacking enemies, collecting power-ups and protecting the cities below.
As you survive longer, the invasion becomes faster and more challenging. Completing waves rewards your progress with achievements, BarkinMad Coins and leaderboard positions.

sections.heading: Increasing Challenge
paragraphs: Every wave introduces greater pressure as enemies attack more aggressively and require quicker reactions. Learning enemy movement patterns and using power-ups effectively becomes increasingly important.
Improving your positioning and survival skills naturally leads to higher scores and longer games.

sections.heading: Progress Beyond Every Game
paragraphs: ZXSpace rewards more than simply achieving a high score. Every completed game contributes towards achievements, shared BarkinMad Coins and your Game Center leaderboard ranking.
This progression system encourages regular play while giving players meaningful long-term goals.

sections.heading: Future Gameplay
paragraphs: ZXSpace has been designed with future expansion in mind. Additional gameplay experiences may be introduced in future updates once the core arcade experience has been fully established.
Any new modes will be announced through the BarkinMad Studios website and app updates as development continues.

images.caption: Defend your cities and survive increasingly difficult alien invasions.

faq.question: What game modes are currently available?
faq.answer: Solo Play is the primary game mode available in ZXSpace, challenging players to defend cities against increasingly difficult alien invasions.

faq.question: Will ZXSpace include multiplayer?
faq.answer: The game has been designed to support future expansion. Additional gameplay modes may be introduced in future updates after the core experience has been established.

faq.question: Does every game mode support achievements?
faq.answer: Solo Play contributes towards Game Center achievements, leaderboard rankings and BarkinMad Coin progression.
